395:t_3:67.en: ～ $$ガルガンティア船団$$ Warehouse Block ～

395:t_3:69.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I figured you hadn't gone back to $c, and sure enough, you're hiding out here.」

395:t_3:71.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I've got the transport sorted. There are people in the fleet who are fed up with the situation as it is, too.」

395:t_3:72.en:
$$レド$$
「Are the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ really there?」

395:t_3:73.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I'll bet on it. I swear on my brother's life.」

395:t_3:75.en:
$$レド$$
「If $c won't move, I'll go by myself.」

395:t_3:76.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I'm counting on you. If you take care of the $$クジライカ$$, we'll handle salvaging the treasure afterward.」

395:t_3:78.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「A legacy of a great age... In short, there's treasure from ancient times.」

395:t_3:79.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「We can sell it for cash, or use its technology to fight the $$サイデリアル$$. Either way, it'll help the fleet's future.」

395:t_3:80.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll leave that part to you.」

395:t_3:81.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Then come to $$フランジ$$'s ship when you're ready.」

395:t_3:82.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「With the fleet still in turmoil, now's our chance to leave without anyone getting in the way.」

395:t_3:83.en:
$$レド$$
「...I have no choice but to do it.」

395:t_3:85.en:
$$レド$$
「$$エイミー$$... And $$ベベル$$ too...」

395:t_3:86.en:
$$ベベル$$
「$$レド$$... where are you planning to go?」

395:t_3:87.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Are you going to fight the $$クジライカ$$?」

395:t_3:90.en:
$$ベベル$$
「The $$クジライカ$$ really are terrifying creatures if you provoke them, but they never attack on their own.」

395:t_3:91.en:
$$エイミー$$
「That's right! Don't you feel sorry for them!?」

395:t_3:92.en:
$$レド$$
「$$エイミー$$ should have learned by now. How terrifying the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are.」

395:t_3:93.en:
$$エイミー$$
「B-but... the $$クジライカ$$ wouldn't attack us.」

395:t_3:94.en:
$$レド$$
「That's only because the fleet's civilization is still immature, so the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are ignoring it for now.」

395:t_3:95.en:
$$レド$$
「Sooner or later they'll bare their fangs. It might be this very moment.」

395:t_3:97.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll strike them before that happens.」

395:t_3:99.en:
$$レド$$
「This is my true purpose. I live to kill them.」

395:t_3:100.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Even if you don't do that, $$レド$$ is still $$レド$$...」

395:t_3:101.en:
$$エイミー$$
「That's right! $$宗介$$ and $$アルト$$ and all the rest are fighters, but they're people first!」

395:t_3:103.en:
$$レド$$
「I... can't live the way they do...」

395:t_3:106.en:
$$エイミー$$
「No! Don't go, I'm begging you!」

395:t_3:107.en:
$$レド$$
「My fight has nothing to do with you.」

395:t_3:109.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't intend to cause the fleet any trouble.」

395:t_3:110.en:
$$エイミー$$
「That's not it! I don't want you doing anything that dangerous!」

395:t_3:111.en:
$$エイミー$$
「And with everyone from $c not even here! I hate it... I just do!」

395:t_3:113.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$レド$$, you... you stubborn idiot!」

395:t_3:116.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Do you really have to go?」

395:t_3:118.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Is that really what you want to do, $$レド$$?」

395:t_3:119.en:
$$レド$$
「It's to protect humanity. And to protect $$エイミー$$, too.」

395:t_3:121.en:
$$レド$$
「...The whistle I gave you when I left the fleet... Do you still have it?」

395:t_3:123.en:
$$レド$$
「It was originally something a child who looked like me was making.」

395:t_3:125.en:
$$レド$$
「Thinking back, he may have been my younger brother.」

395:t_3:127.en:
$$レド$$
「In the $$銀河同盟$$, a child who can't fight can't survive. It's because the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are squeezing humanity's living space.」

395:t_3:129.en:
$$レド$$
「If the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ on Earth expand their territory, they will surely clash with humanity too.」

395:t_3:130.en:
$$ベベル$$
「But the $$クジライカ$$ are...!」

395:t_3:131.en:
$$レド$$
「That is a $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$. If it comes to be like the $$銀河同盟$$, $$ベベル$$ won't be able to go on living. I don't want $$エイミー$$ to go through that kind of parting.」

395:t_3:132.en:
$$ベベル$$
「No... no, $$レド$$! That won't happen!」

395:t_3:133.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't want to make $$エイミー$$ sad. That's why I'll defeat the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$!」

395:t_3:135.en:
$$ベベル$$
「...You'll come back to the fleet, right?」

395:t_3:137.en:
$$ベベル$$
「I'm only keeping that whistle for you. So... promise you'll come back.」

396:t_000:0.en:
$$エイミー$$
「...That party food was delicious.」

396:t_000:2.en:
$$エイミー$$
「It was funny. $$ランド$$ always drinks beer, but $$セツコ$$ started drinking right along with him...」

396:t_000:3.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$クロウ$$ ate and drank like crazy since it was free, and he seemed to be in pain afterward.」

396:t_000:5.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$ and $$エイーダ$$ sang for us too, and it got really lively. $$ベベル$$ said he had fun too.」
